name: FoxAlien Reizer 40W
tagline: FoxAlien Reizer 40W: 40W-class module (10W optical) on an open frame from the CNC brand
tldr: FoxAlien Reizer 40W (sold as Reizer Pro 40W) was the top diode in FoxAlien's laser line, for makers already in the FoxAlien CNC ecosystem. The 40W figure is electrical input: FoxAlien lists 10W optical output, so compare it with 10W machines rather than true 40W optical diodes such as the Atomstack A40 or Ortur H20 40W.
mainObjective: 40W FoxAlien open-frame for cutting-focused hobby or side business

priceRange.note: No longer sold new (Oct 2026); last known price on the official FoxAlien store: $429.99 (Reizer Pro 40W)

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: FoxAlien CNC precision expectations on all materials

pros: Strongest cut headroom in the line: about 8 mm basswood-class stock in benchmarks
10W optical (40W electrical): the most cut-focused head in the FoxAlien Reizer line
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers FoxAlien Reizer 40W. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: High-power FoxAlien laser for cutting and fast engraving.

editorialDepth.advantages: FoxAlien Reizer 40W targets mixed engraving and wood-cutting weeks: fewer passes on basswood and dark acrylic than weaker SKUs in the same line.
editorialDepth.limitations: Wrong pick if you never engrave and only wanted the lowest price. Ultra-fine photo work can look better on an engraving-first SKU. Open-frame: safety and smoke are on you.
